name: STAFF-SPEED-CORE-touch-wakes-idle
old: 'UPDATE staff_sessions SET last_act = ?1 WHERE token_hash = ?2 AND last_act <= ?3 AND last_act > ?4 AND expires_at > ?1',
new: 'UPDATE staff_sessions SET last_act = ?1 WHERE token_hash = ?2 AND last_act <= ?3 AND (last_act > ?4 OR 1) AND expires_at > ?1',
why: the folded touch, landing before the lookup, brings a session past its idle back to life

name: STAFF-SPEED-CORE-touch-spent-life
old: 'UPDATE staff_sessions SET last_act = ?1 WHERE token_hash = ?2 AND last_act <= ?3 AND last_act > ?4 AND expires_at > ?1',
new: 'UPDATE staff_sessions SET last_act = ?1 WHERE token_hash = ?2 AND last_act <= ?3 AND last_act > ?4 AND (expires_at > ?1 OR 1)',
why: the touch never moves expires_at, so a session past its 8 hours is still refused and deleted below whichever lands first, and every reader of last_act (staffHidden.js LIVE_SQL, safety.js claims, the Team page) asks expires_at too. Kept so the touch never writes a dead row.
